paite: Hiaite Israel tapate ahi uh: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issakar, Zebulun;
heading: Israel Suante

paite: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad leh Asher.
Judah tapate: Er, Onan leh Shelah; huaite Shuah tanu Kanaan nu a kipan amah lak a piang thumte ahi uh. Huan TOUPA mitmuh in Judah ta masapen Er agi kei a; amah athat hi.
Huchi in Tamar atapa zi in Perez leh Zerah asuansak hi. Judah tapate tengteng nga ahi uh.
Perez tapate: Hezron leh Hamul ahi uh.
Huan Zerah tapate: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Kalkol leh Dara: avek un nga ahi uh.
Huan Karmi tapate: Akar, thil siangthou a talekpa, Israel hihbuaipa.
Huan Ethan tapa Azariah ahi.
Hezron, amah lak a piangte leng; Jerahmeel, Ram leh Kelubai.
heading: Kumpipa David Khanggui

paite: Huan Ram in Amminadab asuang a; Amminadab in Nahson, Judah suante lal asuang hi.
Nahson in Salma asuang a, Salma in Boaz asuang;
Boaz in Obed asuang a, Obed in Jesse asuang hi.
Jesse in ata masapen Eliab, anihna Abinadab leh athumna Shimea asuang;
alina Nethaneel, angana Raddai;
agukna Ozem, asagihna David.
Huan asanggamnute uh Zeruiah leh Abigail ahi uh. Huchi in Zeruiah tapate: Abishai, Joab leh Asahel, thum ahi uh.
Abigail in Amasa asuang a, huan Amasa pa Ishmael mi Jether ahi.
Huan Jezron tapa Kaleb in Azubah azi leh Jerioth lak ah tate asuang a; hiaite atapate ahi: Jesher leh Shobab leh Ardon.
heading: Hezron Suante

paite: Azubah asi a, Kaleb in amah a ding in Ephrath api a, huai in Hur aneihsak hi.
Hur in Uri asuang a, Uri in Bezaleel asuang hi.
Huai nung in Gilead pa Makir tanu kiang ah Hezron alut a; huai zi dia api lai in kum sawmguk a upa ahi; ama'n Segub asuansak hi.
Segub in, Gilead gam a khopi sawmnih-le-thum nei Jair, asuansak hi.
Ama'n amau a kipan Kenath leh huai a khoneite, khopi sawmguk toh Geshur, Aramin leh Jair khuate ala hi. Hiaite tengteng Gilead pa Makir tapate a ahi uh.
Huai nung in Kaleb-ephrathah ah Hezron asi a, huchi in Hezron zi Abia in Tekoa pa Ashur asuansak hi.
Huan Hezron ta masapen Jerahmeel tapate: ata masapen Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem leh Ahijah ahi uh.
heading: Jerahmeel Suante

paite: Jerahmeel in zi dang anei a, amin Atarah ahi; amah Onam nu ahi.
Jerahmeel ta masapen Ram tapate Maaz, Jamin leh Eker ahi uh.
Onam tapate: Shammai leh Jada ahi uh. Shammai tapate: Nadab leh Abishur ahi uhi.
Abishur zi min Abihail ahi; ama'n Ahban leh Molid asuansak hi.
Nadab tapate: Seled leh Appaim ahi ua, Seled bel tate nei lou in asi hi.
Appaim tapa Ishi ahi. Ishi tapa Sheshan ahi. Sheshan tapa Ahlai ahi.
Huan Shammai unaupa Jada tapate: Jether leh Jonathan ahi ua; Jether ta nei lou in asi hi.
Huan Jonathan tapate: Peleth, Zaza ahi uh. Hiaite Jerahmeel tapate ahi uh.
Huchi in Sheshan in, tanute chih louh, tapate anei kei hi. Huan Sheshan in Aigupta mi khat sikha anei a, amin Jarha ahi.
Huan Sheshan in asikha Jarha kiang ah zi ding in atanu apia a; huchi in Attai aneihsak hi.
Huan Attai in Nathan asuang a, Nathan in Zabad asuang;
Zabad in Ephlal asuang; Ephlal in Obed asuang;
Obed in Jehu asuang a, Jehu in Azariah asuang;
Azariah in Helez asuang a, Helez in Eleasah asuang hi;
Eleasah in Sisamai asuang a, Sisamai in Shallum asuang;
Shallum in Jekamiah asuang a, Jekamiah in Elishama asuang hi.
Huchi in Jerahmeel unaupa Kaleb tapate: Ata masapen Mesha ahi a; amah Ziph pa ahi, huan Mareshah ahi a, amah Hebron pa ahi.
heading: Kaleb Suante

paite: Huan Hebron tapate: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, Shema ahi uh.
Shema in Raham, Jorkoam pa asuang; Rekem in Shammai asuang hi.
Huan Shammai tapa Maon ahi; Beth-zur pa Maon ahi.
Ephah, Kaleb mei in, Haran, Moza leh Gazez asuang a: Haran in Gazez asuang hi.
Jahdai tapate: Regem, Jotham, Gesan, Pelet, Ephah leh Shaaph ahi uh.
Maakah, Kaleb mei in, Sheber leh Tirhanah anei a.
Madmannah pa Shaaph, Makbenah pa leh Gibea pa Sheva anei a; Kaleb tanu Aksah ahi.
Hiaite Kaleb tapate ahi uh: Ephrathah ta masapen Hur tapa, Kiriath-jearim pa Shobal;
Bethlehem pa Salma, Bethgader pa Hareph.
Kiriath-jearim pa Shobal in tapate anei a; Haroeh leh Menaheth kimkhatte ahi ua,
Kiriath-jearim inkote; Ithrit mite, Puthit mite, Shumathit mite, Misrai mite; Zareathit mite leh Eshtaol mite hong kipatna ahi.
Salma tapate: Bethlehem, Netophah mite, Joab inkuante Atroth-beth, Zorit mite, Manahathit mite kimkhatte ahi uh.
Huan Jabez a teng laigelhmite inkote: Tirathit mite, Shimeathit mite, leh Sukathit mite. Hiaite Ken mi Rekab inkote pa, Hemath a kipan hong paite ahi uhi.
